set.body: Owner requests a strong effort to validate transform quality. Freeze a prospective validation protocol, audit reference independence, measure real-label and mask consequences of Workbench differences, evaluate both volume directions on regional alignment/deformation/boundary metrics, and produce a reviewable visual packet. Preserve frozen release gates and failures; distinguish numerical agreement, dependent anatomical diagnostics, and genuinely independent anatomical evidence. CIFTI review is owned by codex-cifti-review and is outside this campaign.
set.title: Validate anatomical and practical quality of released transforms
